gloss: boar; twelfth sign of the zodiac

definitions.gloss: boar; twelfth sign of the zodiac
definitions.explanation: The twelfth and final sign of the twelve-year East Asian zodiac cycle, represented in Japan by the wild boar. Used mainly to label zodiac years, and traditionally also certain hours and directions in classical astrology.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{亥|い}{年|どし}だ。
examples.english: This year is the year of the boar.

examples.japanese: {亥|い}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{十二支|じゅうにし}→十二支：27602_juunishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧だ。
examples.english: The boar is the last animal in the zodiac cycle.

examples.japanese: {亥|い}{年|どし}⟦{生|う}まれ→生まれ：01867_umare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一途|いちず}→一途：18242_ichizu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}き{者|もの}→働き者：11528_hatarakimono⟧だと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: People born in the year of the boar are said to be single-minded and hard-working.

notes:
{亥|い} is the twelfth and final sign of the East Asian zodiac cycle, represented in Japan by the wild boar (⟦{猪|いのしし}→猪：04349_inoshishi⟧).

USAGE:
Mainly appears in the fixed form {亥|い}{年|どし} (year of the boar) and in the zodiac sequence itself; it is rarely used alone outside these contexts.

CULTURAL NOTE:
In China and other countries that share this zodiac cycle, the same sign is represented by a domestic pig (⟦{豚|ぶた}→豚：04710_buta⟧) rather than a wild boar, a difference that sometimes surprises learners.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {亥|い}{年|どし}: year of the boar
- {亥|い}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方角|ほうがく}→方角：08447_hougaku⟧: the boar direction (north-northwest, in classical usage)
